_note: Photo candidates for the 26 new Copenhagen trees. Every file is by Hans Erik Lund, who gave written permission by mail on 2026-09-20: free use with the credit '(c) Hans Erik Lund'. Judge them against the Cadiz standard. Nothing here is approved until somebody has LOOKED at it.

candidates.name: The Hawthorn of Nordpolen
candidates.address: Nordpolen, the wild green corner of De Gamles By, north of Norre Alle, facing Tagensvej, Norrebro
candidates.register_legend: Tjørnen er en af de sidste rester af et gammelt overdrev. Træet forsøges skånet fra byggeplaner. Disse er dog indstillet indtil videre (august 2018).

candidates.name: Trepileegen, the Three-Willow Oak of Dyrehaven
candidates.address: Jaegersborg Dyrehave (the royal deer park), Lyngby-Taarbaek Kommune, near the park's cluster of named veteran oaks
candidates.register_legend: Marts 2017 er omkredsen målt til 8,90 m 1,30 m over terræn.

candidates.name: The Field Maple of Hans Tavsens Park
candidates.address: Hans Tavsens Park, opposite Jesper Brochmands Gade, Norrebro
candidates.register_legend: Træet er pt. Danmarks 3.-tykkeste. (De to navr i Dragsholm Park er 2 registreringe af samme træ). Flere større grene i kronen er savet af, en del mindre grene er tørre.

candidates.name: Kuppelegen, the Dome Oak of Dyrehaven
candidates.address: Jaegersborg Dyrehave (the royal deer park), Lyngby-Taarbaek Kommune, about 100 metres from Trepileegen

candidates.name: Vorteegen, the Wart Oak of Dyrehaven
candidates.address: Jaegersborg Dyrehave (the royal deer park), Lyngby-Taarbaek Kommune, on the open prairie-like grassland area
candidates.register_legend: Marts 2017 blev omkredsen målt til 8,48 m og højden til 16,5 m.

candidates.name: The Hornbeam of Grondalsparken
candidates.address: Grondalsparken, about 100 metres southwest of Grondal station, east of the path
candidates.register_legend: 4 - 5 stammer

candidates.name: Raunkiaer's Oak, the Burnt Oak of Dyrehaven
candidates.address: Jaegersborg Dyrehave (the royal deer park), Lyngby-Taarbaek Kommune, on the oak between Dalvej and Chausseen

candidates.name: The Weeping Silver Lime of J.C. Jacobsens Have
candidates.address: J.C. Jacobsens Have, Carlsberg Byen, at the southern end by the path around the southwest lawn
candidates.register_legend: Flere hovedgrene er holdt sammen med wirer

candidates.name: The Field Maple of Kaerholmen
candidates.address: Grondalsparken, facing the building at Kaerholmen
candidates.register_legend: Solitær. Mange grene eller stammer fra ca. 1 m højde

candidates.name: The Fern-leaved Beech of the National Gallery
candidates.address: Statens Museum for Kunst (the National Gallery of Denmark), by the northeastern gable of the museum, facing Oster Anlaeg
candidates.register_legend: Mange rodslåede grene, hvoraf flere af uforståelige gunde er kappet fra stammen.

candidates.name: The Oriental Plane of J.C. Jacobsens Have
candidates.address: J.C. Jacobsens Have, Carlsberg Byen, on the round lawn to the west, about 20 metres from the honorary residence
candidates.register_legend: Meget ujævn nederst på stammen

candidates.name: The Beech of Holmens Kirkegard
candidates.address: Holmens Kirkegard, by the western path, about 50 metres from the northern corner
candidates.register_legend: Store rodudløb, næsten en elefantfod en halv metger oppe på stammen

candidates.name: The Japanese Pagoda Tree of Rolighedsvej
candidates.address: Immediately east of Sankt Thomas Kirke, at the junction of Rolighedsvej and L.I. Brandes Alle, Frederiksberg
candidates.register_legend: Træet blev desværre kraftigt beskåret for et par år siden. Der er store barkskader mod S og Ø på de nederste 2 m.

candidates.name: The Caucasian Wingnut of Allegade
candidates.address: A park by Allegade 17, Frederiksberg (Allegade runs along the east side of Frederiksberg Have and holds a public rose garden entered from Allegade 20; our sources describe the tree as standing in 'the park at Allegade' but do not name the exact plot)

candidates.name: The London Plane of Landbohojskolens Have
candidates.address: Landbohojskolens Have (the Royal Veterinary and Agricultural University's garden, now University of Copenhagen Frederiksberg Campus), behind the former auditorium VII (now the festival auditorium)

candidates.name: The Zelkova of Landbohojskolens Have
candidates.address: Landbohojskolens Have, about 50 metres south of the garden's northeastern corner
candidates.register_legend: Træet består af 4 stammer. Der er svampeangreb ved den SØ stamme.

candidates.name: The Plane Tree of Rosenvaenget
candidates.address: Pavement outside Rosenvaengets Alle 30, at the corner of Rosenvaengets Alle and Saabyesvej, Osterbro
candidates.register_legend: Sund, dele af kronen rækker ind over taget på nærmeste etagebolig.

candidates.name: The Lanceleaf Cottonwood of Bispebjerg Kirkegard
candidates.address: Bispebjerg Kirkegard, on the lawn between Nordre and Sondre Kapel, nearest the northern one
candidates.register_legend: Består af en gruppe på 3 træer. Mål gælder det nordligste træ. Der er nogen forskel på bladenes længde i forhold til bredden. Der er ikke noget officielt dansk navn til poppelarten.

candidates.name: The Catalpa of Haveselskabets Have
candidates.address: Haveselskabets Have, Frederiksberg, just inside the entrance
candidates.register_legend: Tvege fra 2 m.

candidates.name: The Tulip Tree of J.C. Jacobsens Have
candidates.address: J.C. Jacobsens Have, Carlsberg Byen, on the western lawn toward the northwest

candidates.name: Fortunegen, the Fortune Oak of Dyrehaven
candidates.address: Jaegersborg Dyrehave (the royal deer park), Lyngby-Taarbaek Kommune, east of Fortunporthuset gatehouse, north of Fortunvej
candidates.register_legend: Kronen er meget assymmetrisk, klemt i nordsiden

candidates.name: The Black Locust of Lindevangsparken
candidates.address: Lindevangsparken, southeastern corner, Frederiksberg
candidates.register_legend: Stor barkskade på sydsiden.

candidates.name: The Cherry Avenue of Bispebjerg Kirkegard
candidates.address: Bispebjerg Kirkegard, the cherry avenue (Kirsebaeralleen)
candidates.register_legend: Alleen er kendt langt udenfor Danmarks grænser og besøges af mange mennesker. Blomstrer normalt sidst i april

candidates.name: The Caucasian Oak of Vestre Kirkegard
candidates.address: Vestre Kirkegard, section I (afsnit I)
candidates.register_legend: Træet er podet på en stilkeg. Der er en del vanrispuder nederst på stammen, der medfører at omkredsen er ca. 4,0 i 1,3 m højde. Kommentar: Træ nr. 2 på oversigtskortet

candidates.name: The Service Tree of J.C. Jacobsens Have
candidates.address: J.C. Jacobsens Have, Carlsberg Byen, 40 metres due north of the fountain
candidates.register_legend: Stort og smukt træ

candidates.name: The Hungarian Oak of Bispebjerg Kirkegard
candidates.address: Bispebjerg Kirkegard, about 90 metres northwest of Nordre Kapel
candidates.register_legend: Fritstående og fuldkronet, sund
